query:
SELECT 
  e.nome AS escola,
  e.inep,
  e.municipio,
  t.nome AS tecnico,
  os.observacao AS rdo,
  os.dataConclusao AS data_conclusao,
  os.qtdApInstalado AS aps_instalados
FROM ordens_servico os
JOIN escolas e ON os.escolaId = e.id
LEFT JOIN tecnicos t ON os.tecnicoId = t.id
WHERE os.status = 'concluida'
  AND os.observacao IS NOT NULL
  AND os.observacao != ''
ORDER BY os.dataConclusao DESC;
